evals.prompt: pages/ 폴더에 이미 HTML 파일들이 있어: index.html, about.html, location.html, process.html. 그리고 public/css, public/js, public/images 폴더에 에셋도 다 있어. 이걸 Next.js App Router 프로젝트로 만들어줘. 각 페이지마다 route.ts 파일 만들고, next.config.ts도 설정해줘.
evals.expected_output: app/route.ts (index), app/about/route.ts, app/location/route.ts, app/process/route.ts 생성. next.config.ts에 cache headers 설정. 각 route.ts는 readFileSync로 pages/XXX.html 읽어서 text/html로 응답.

evals.prompt: I want to clone the website at https://sominclinic.com/ as a Next.js app. I want the pages: /, /about, /location, /process, /philosophy. Show me the full plan and set it up.
evals.expected_output: Skill should explain the clone_site.py command to run, describe the expected directory output, and generate route.ts files for each page.

assertions.name: clone_site.py command shown
assertions.check: response mentions clone_site.py with the URL

assertions.name: route structure explained
assertions.check: response shows or generates app/about/route.ts pattern

evals.prompt: 병원 사이트를 Next.js로 배포하고 싶어. 현재 폴더에 pages/ 폴더가 있고 안에 HTML 파일들이 있는데 clone-manifest.json 파일은 없어. setup_nextjs 스크립트를 써서 자동으로 route.ts 파일들 만들어줘.
evals.expected_output: setup_nextjs.py 스크립트를 실행해서 pages/*.html에서 clone-manifest.json을 자동 생성하고, 모든 HTML 파일에 대한 route.ts 파일을 생성해야 함.

assertions.name: clone-manifest.json auto-generated from pages/
assertions.check: clone-manifest.json created containing all 6 html filenames

assertions.name: route.ts files generated for all pages
assertions.check: app/ contains route.ts files for index, about, location, process, general, philosophy

assertions.name: setup_nextjs.py script was used
assertions.check: setup_nextjs.py was invoked (not manual file creation)
